method: Built-in image_gen for raster background reconstruction and isolated guides. Original supplied JPEGs are preserved intact; ornate UI slices are composed at runtime using SVG with live text and controls.
references: Six user-supplied 14A1201C-BDE7-43B6-A99A-6A20335748E6 photos, copied as reference-1.jpg through reference-6.jpg.

Extract the smiling deer archer guide at upper left, antlers through waist, with green cape, leather armour and quiver. Preserve reference face and pose. Transparent background; remove all scenery, lettering and UI.

Remove all UI, headers, panels, text, numbers, ticks, glowing marker, answer circles, navigation and fox. Preserve the exact Acropolis scenery and stone bridge across the middle, columns, waterfalls, lake, floor, banners and torches. Wide landscape composition.
